thread:
alice.dev: incident-bot just fired: P0 - serving-runtime multiple-task failures on tp4 pool, likely collective hang + OOM on node gpu-34. attaching initial logs.
incident-bot: INC-2026-834 created at 5001234567; severity=P0; alert: NCCL hang detected, container restarted 2x. Assigned: sam.oncall.
sam.oncall: I'm on it. quick question — customer-facing impact?
alice.dev: cust-search cluster shows 15% of requests 504s for the last 3m. Two training jobs for partner-X failed mid-epoch.
ben.infra: looking at kube events for gpu-34: kubelet observed OOMKill for container redwood-runtime (oom_kill):
```
May 10 12:01:02 gpu-34 kernel: Out of memory: Killed process 32211 (redwood-runtime) total-vm:...
May 10 12:01:02 gpu-34 nv_peer_mem: failed to allocate DMA memory
```
ben.infra: also seeing repeated NCCL ERROR "unreachable" and communicator timeouts in logs.
lina.ops: starting node cordon: `kubectl cordon gpu-34` — will attempt to drain. PV eviction could block.
sam.oncall: good call. before drain, can we set a per-workload fallback to single-GPU so inference traffic avoids multi-GPU collective? alice, can you push route override?
alice.dev: applied route override for workload=search: REROUTE_MODE=single-gpu via console (propagating).
emily.sre: running nvtop and nvidia-smi on gpu-34 — GPU memory shows fragmentation; one process holding 48GB on GPU0, other processes stuck in NCCL comms. suspect a straggler causing repeated rendezvous waits.
ben.infra: kernel logs also show Xid 79 once, then a container restart. After restart the process tries to rejoin rendezvous and hits timeout.
sam.oncall: plan: 1) cordon+drain node, 2) evict stuck container (force), 3) restart rendezvous coordinator service on remaining nodes, 4) enable temporary soft-timeout fallback to shorter NCCL timeouts. Who can run the force-evict?
lina.ops: force-evict started: `kubectl delete pod --force --grace-period=0 pod/rt-32211 -n serving` — eviction completed.
ben.infra: I restarted the rendezvous agent (rt-rendezvous) on tp4-leader: `systemctl restart rt-rendezvous` — logs show new leader elected.
emily.sre: adjusted NCCL_TIMEOUT_MS from 60000 -> 20000 via configmap rollout to reduce long hangs. rolling update initiated.
sam.oncall: monitoring. cust-success, can you loop in an update to the impacted customer? we need to be clear on mitigation and ETA.
cust-success: notifying partner-X: "We've identified a multi-GPU collective failure causing intermittent 504s. We've routed traffic to single-GPU fallbacks and forced eviction of a stuck pod. Full node drain in progress; next update in 30m."
pagerduty-bot: escalated to eng-sre after 12m with summary: NCCL hang + OOM -> forced eviction + config rollback possible.
alice.dev: post-mortem note: we should add health-check for long rendezvous join time and automatic single-GPU fallback in routing layer. filing follow-up jira.
sam.oncall: things are stabilizing — request rate errors down to baseline, no new OOMs on other nodes. leaving open for 30m to confirm.
incident-bot: INC-2026-834 status: mitigation applied, monitoring. will mark stable after 00:30.
